title: Call gpt-5.6-luna for one computerless turn
description:
Replace the computerless worker's FakeTextCompletionClient with a real OpenAI client when OPENAI_API_KEY is present. Model is gpt-5.6-luna (OPENAI_MODEL in .env, default gpt-5.6-luna).

Why now: the HTTP SSE thin turn exists in-process. The next unknown is an actual model loop, not more transport.

Acceptance:
- CI (GitHub Actions, no key) still uses the fake client and stays green.
- python-dotenv loads Chattic.us/.env locally. Never commit .env.
- One pytest marked for live OpenAI runs when the key is set; skip when absent.
- That test posts a text-only channel message, runs ComputerlessWorker with the live client, and asserts one durable bot answer and a completed turn stream. Do not assert exact wording.
- No Bedrock, no xAI, no second vendor.
- Do not deploy in this task.

Key already verified against GET /v1/models/gpt-5.6-luna and a tiny chat completion. Do not print the secret.
